content.value_statement: Teams need consistent Anthropic visual styling across documents and slides. This skill provides colors, typography rules, and formatting guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Lists Anthropic brand colors with hex values and intended uses.
Defines heading and body font choices with fallback fonts.
Guides text styling for headings, body copy, hierarchy, and readability.
Explains accent color use for shapes and visual elements.
Documents RGB color application for presentation workflows using python-pptx.
limitations: It does not install fonts or verify local font availability.
It does not include executable automation scripts.
It does not validate legal approval for brand use.
It only covers the colors and typography documented in the skill.

use_cases.title: Style Presentation Drafts
use_cases.description: Apply documented colors, fonts, and accent rules to slide decks that need a consistent Anthropic visual style.

use_cases.title: Format Technical Documents
use_cases.description: Use the typography and color guidance to improve readability in reports, guides, and internal documents.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Materials
use_cases.description: Align demos, handouts, and summary visuals with a shared brand style before review or distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Basic Brand Styling
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to restyle my artifact with the documented Anthropic colors and typography. Preserve the structure and improve readability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner styling for an existing document or slide deck.

prompt_templates.title: Review Visual Consistency
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this presentation for alignment with the skill's colors, fonts, and accent usage. List the changes you recommend.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before sharing a visual artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Brand Style Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Before editing, map each section of my document to heading, body, accent, and background styling from this skill.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a larger document or presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Multi-Format Materials
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the skill across slides, handouts, and summary graphics. Keep typography, color roles, and hierarchy consistent across formats.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced adaptation across several related deliverables.

output_examples.input: A draft slide deck uses mixed fonts, bright colors, and inconsistent heading sizes.
output_examples.output: The skill would assign Poppins to large headings, Lora to body text, and documented accents to supporting shapes.

output_examples.input: A report needs a cleaner visual hierarchy and brand-aligned color treatment.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend dark text on light backgrounds, clear heading roles, and limited accent color use.

output_examples.input: A team wants consistent styling across a slide deck and a one-page handout.
output_examples.output: The skill would align typography, color roles, and accent placement so both assets feel related.

best_practices: Install Poppins and Lora before high-fidelity presentation work.
Use dark and light colors for contrast before applying accents.
Keep accent colors limited to shapes, highlights, and supporting visual elements.
anti_patterns: Do not use accent colors as the only source of meaning.
Do not replace all typography with a single font.
Do not claim brand approval without separate review from the brand owner.

faq.question: Does this skill install fonts?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Poppins and Lora and provides Arial and Georgia fallbacks.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for guidance-driven styling tasks.

faq.question: Does it change files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides styling instructions. The agent must apply changes using available tools.

faq.question: Is it only for presentations?
faq.answer: No. It can guide documents, slides, and visual artifacts that need consistent brand styling.

faq.question: Does it include official legal approval?
faq.answer: No. It does not replace brand, legal, or trademark approval.

faq.question: What assets does it define?
faq.answer: It defines color roles, accent colors, font choices, and RGB color guidance.
